# Any scope. THE switch for the survival lines (design 4.2): the empire's stage is 2 (restoration) or higher. Readable
# from any scope (it looks at c:BYZ itself); false when the empire is gone or the line has not run yet.
oe_sr_strong = {
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_sr_tier var:oe_sr_tier >= 2 }
}
# BYZ scope. The Ottomans are gone, joined to the empire (the first maker's restoration chain), or weaker than the
# empire by the January count's measure (military_strength; G3).
oe_sr_ott_weak = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { country_exists = c:TUR }
        has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active
        AND = { has_variable = oe_sr_ms_tur has_variable = oe_sr_ms_byz var:oe_sr_ms_tur < var:oe_sr_ms_byz }
    }
}
